pattern.name: Night aperture relief
pattern.description: An off-center observatory aperture uses wide interrupted crescent steps and two rectangular notches. Its asymmetric nested opening differs from flowing curves, feather stripes, and circular light orbits.

background.status: Designed presentation for the owner-delegated redesign batch; independent of native artwork and product UI colors.

framing.note: Uniform centered 90% placement protects both ear tufts, the complete feather, and every talon. The compact whole owl remains intact.

matte.calibrationNote: Native exterior samples are near-white rather than pure white. Border-connected extraction uses a source-specific matte sample; enclosed eye highlights and warm ivory anatomy are protected by connectivity and chroma. No connected-component cleanup is applied in this pass; inspect every remaining component and both light/dark boundaries.
